Variants.Content: Red Lake City is located in the west of the Reach, close to the Westerlands. The lake, wetlands and surrounding fields make it a place where water and land meet: timber and fish can be transported on the lake, and grain, pasture and roads leading inland can be found on the shore. The borders of the Reach are not as clear as the Wall, and western strongholds like Red Lake City often feel the food order of Highgarden and the minerals, knights, and mountain roads of the Westerlands at the same time. The color of the lake can become a legend, but it cannot replace the actual banks, ferries and grain stores. Its value comes from regulating border trade and local transportation, not the inevitable outcome of a future war.

Entry Red Lake They care about grain, wine, orchards, pastures and markets along the Mander River. They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
